answer: Stop sybils with a glacier escrow, a sparrow courier net, and a raven audit. Each identity locks a bond in a glacier vault that thaws one layer per epoch, so a bond cannot cover a second identity. Influence travels only by sparrow: each courier carries one endorsement per epoch, and a courier used twice voids both claims. A raven auditor samples couriers; when two share one funder, the raven merges them into one standing and slashes every bond behind them by the merged count. A lone participant stakes once; N copies stake N times, gain one share, and forfeit roughly N squared when caught.
